title: Edgeless Window Content Scroll Clearance
description: All content inside all windows must be edgeless. Remove padding inset; use scroll clearance so the first line is hidden under chrome by default but scrolls into view when scrolling up. Applies to writer, tables, and all window bodies.
summary: Reverted scroll-through-first-line overlap behavior. Chrome-aware windows (writer, forms, table, editor, vfs) use invisible top inset via `data-window-content-layout=chrome-aware` and `windowBodyChromeAwareInsetClass`; puzzle/canvas windows stay `edgeless` with no inset. Window measures live chrome height into `--window-chrome-scroll-clearance`. Writer camera offset removed; padding keeps content below chrome while scrolling.
